description: A component binds `'[tabindex]': 'order()'` and declares `order = input(2)`, and 2.4.3 keeps resting on the scan. Every consumer who sets nothing gets the library's own two, and a template of the library can set any other: an input holds what a template gives it, and the reading refuses it as a value it cannot judge. The binding holds no digit and the input no `tabindex`, so the scan found none.
